Her 1 audit: Table lists Her 1 as AM with K-band VLA flux 48 +/-17 uJy, +100 +/-45 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.00?, distance=1030 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; no source-specific WD surface MG field, WD Teff, WD mass, or donor properties are provided. Cas 1 audit: Table lists C-band flux 21 +/-10 uJy, -100 +/-39 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.9396 h, distance=1608 pc, and radio-inferred B=1960 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1503-2207 audit: Table lists X-band flux 29 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-14 percent circular polarization, Porb=2.2228 h, distance=392 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FR Lyn correction after rendered Table 1 check: FR Lyn has only the Semester 18A X-band row, I=28 +/-4 uJy, RR=12 +/-6, LL=38 +/-6, CP=-52 +/-17%, offset=0.13 +/-0.22 arcsec, composite S/N1=43.3. The 49 +/-29 uJy K-band row with +37 +/-57% CP belongs to VV Pup Semester 13B. FR Lyn has no radio-inferred B entry in Table 2. BM CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 43 +/-15 uJy, -100 +/-41 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4040 h, distance=419 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. Hya 1 audit: Pelisoli+24 Appendix explicitly maps Hya 1 to RX J0859.1+0537; the prior Gaia DR3 5745881603063095680 match was a different source, MM Hya. Barrett+20 reports X-band Stokes I 6±6 μJy and custom S/N 7.3, but Ridder+23 treats the point as below 3σ. Its 2.3966 h and 441 pc values are consistent with the RX J0859 literature and Gaia DR2/EDR3 distances; the 3563±730 G inference remains conditional radio-plasma field, not WD surface field. V388 Peg audit: Table lists X-band flux 34 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-12 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3751 h, distance=689 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FL Cet audit: Table lists X-band flux 11 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-53 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4523 h, distance=319 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-pole field measured from cyclotron harmonics by Schmidt+05_FLCet. LW Cam audit: Table lists X-band flux 50 +/-4 uJy, -100 +/-9 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.6211 h, distance=542 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; Section 4.2 identifies a narrow ~10.295 GHz feature and derives ~3.6 kG for the radio plasma while adopting/citing Bwd~20 MG from Ferrario+15/Tovmassian+01_LWCam.
